title: Geohazard Change Detection for Emergency Management with GRASS
description:
Materials for a hands-on workshop at FOSS4G NA 2026 (Sacramento, 2026-11-02). Participants build an uncertainty-aware lidar change detection workflow in GRASS with the r.dem toolset and apply it to Humbug Creek, California, which burned in the 2022 McKinney Fire and was hit four days later by a storm that dropped about 4 in of rain on the burn scar.

Code is GPL-3.0. Workshop text is CC BY 4.0. Data keep their original terms, listed in data/README.md.
notes: Supported by the U.S. National Science Foundation under award 2606178, GEO OSE Track 2: Open Geoscience Accelerator: Building the Contributor Pipeline.
